title: Whitespace Normalizer
h1: Whitespace Normalizer — Clean Extra Spaces and Lines
seoTitle: Free Whitespace Cleaner — Remove Extra Spaces Online
description: Normalize whitespace in text by collapsing multiple spaces, trimming lines, and removing empty lines. Private browser-based tool.
intro: Clean up messy pasted text by normalizing spaces and line breaks. Everything happens locally.
blurb: Collapse extra spaces and tidy line breaks in any text.
howItWorks: Paste text that has irregular spacing.
Click Normalize to collapse multiple spaces into one and trim each line.
Review the cleaned output and copy it.
examples: Multiple spaces between words become single spaces.
Leading and trailing spaces on lines are removed.

faq.a: It replaces sequences of whitespace with a single space, trims each line, and removes completely empty lines.

faq.q: Does it change punctuation or letters?
faq.a: No. Only whitespace is adjusted; all other characters stay the same.
